fixer.title: sessions: stop the customization migration badge flickering

introducer.title: Hide migration notice after migrations are ignored

cases.mechanism: Each customization refresh forced a synchronous true-to-false observable notification and navigation-icon DOM rewrite before async migration discovery, followed by a second false-to-true rewrite when the same hint returned.
cases.symptom: The migration indicator repeatedly flickered in an otherwise idle Sessions sidebar, with redundant DOM icon updates on each customization refresh.
cases.fixedBehavior: Deleting the eager false assignment preserves the last completed value while discovery is pending. An unchanged true result no longer produces an observable transition or icon DOM rewrite; a genuinely changed result still updates once after discovery completes.
cases.evidence: The deleted base-revision line synchronously set migrationAvailable from true to false before every async computeMigrationHint refresh. That observable feeds SessionSectionRenderer.customizationsIcon; renderSessionHeaderIcon's autorun responds by clearing the icon node and rewriting its class, color, and display, then repeats those DOM writes when the unchanged hint resolves true. onDidChangeCustomizations can fire while the Sessions navigation is visible, so each refresh caused the reported visible indicator flicker and two unnecessary render transitions.
